description: This file contains functions and logic for managing sandbox environments, including workspace setup, Docker user resolution, session resolution, and sandbox context creation in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: ensureSandboxWorkspaceLayout
methods.description: Sets up the sandbox workspace layout, including directory resolution and skill synchronization.

methods.name: resolveSandboxDockerUser
methods.description: Resolves the Docker user configuration, defaulting to filesystem UID:GID if not specified.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSession
methods.description: Resolves session information and sandbox runtime status based on session key.

methods.name: resolveSandboxContext
methods.description: Creates and returns a sandbox context object, including backend, browser, and filesystem bridge, based on session and configuration.

methods.name: ensureSandboxWorkspaceForSession
methods.description: Ensures the sandbox workspace exists for a given session and returns workspace info.
